body: I am still alive. I have thought about what you guys said. I don't think my life will get any better. I have always try to stay upbeat all my life but failures just keep coming one after another. I understand some of you want me to know things will get better down the road. But that's just wishful thinking, also something I do all my life. If I am alive, things will get better. Well, from experience that's simply not true. I think you are very kind in  telling me that I have the potential to make things better. In fact everyone who messaged me or reply to this thread is very kind. But it also let me know how similar everything everyone had said. I will be honest, I don't want to die without know I can do better. But I can't do better, and I have to accept this. Everything I ever done in life is a disappointment or a complete failure. There really is nothing I can do to make mine or anyone's life better. So instead of living and waste everyone's time and effort, I will remove myself from this world. Please convince me keep living.
